channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Indiana Gets Federal Disaster Aid After Storms Kill Five
item.description: At least five people died in Indiana amid severe storms and floods, with President Donald Trump approving an emergency declaration for the inundated Midwestern state.

item.title: US shootings: 1 killed, 4 hurt in Kentucky park attack; 4 wounded in Chicago
item.description: A Kentucky park shooting left one dead and four injured, while a separate Chicago drive-by shooting wounded four, including two critically. Police are investigating both incidents. Police in both cities were investigating, with no immediate arrests or motives reported.

item.title: First time an AI boss fires a human? AI boss Luna fires human employee in ‘first known’ case of its kind – Here's why
item.description: An AI manager running an experimental San Francisco shop has decided to fire a human employee after repeated lateness, marking a striking test of how far autonomous AI can go in managing people.

item.title: Quote of the day by Khaled Hosseini: ‘But better to get hurt by the truth than…’
item.description: The quote highlighted a fundamental choice in human relationships: the choice between temporary comfort and enduring reality.

item.title: 'Complete chaos!': CJP's Dipke joins Bombay HC clerk typing test protest; flags server glitches failing students
item.description: CJP convenor Abhijeet Dipke joined a protest by Bombay High Court clerk recruitment candidates, who accused technical issues and server glitches of impacting their online exam. They called for a retest, claiming many were unfairly declared unsuccessful amid computer malfunctions.

item.title: CISF personnel suspended after woman alleges he photographed her in Delhi Metro: 'Matter viewed with utmost seriousness'
item.description: A CISF personnel has been suspended and an inquiry ordered after a woman allegedly accused him of photographing her inside a Delhi Metro coach near AIIMS. The confrontation later escalated into a scuffle with passengers.

item.title: Virginia State University shooting: 19-year-old suspect arrested; police looking for additional gunmen
item.description: Camron Harris of Henrico, Virginia, was found hiding in a dormitory closet and arrested in connection with the shooting, Chesterfield County Police said. Harris is not a VSU student, and four of the five people injured were also not students.

item.title: Three H-1B rejections later, an Indian techie secures O-1 ‘extraordinary ability’ Visa
item.description: By February 2026, the Indian techie and his lawyers had compiled a massive portfolio consisting of more than 700 pages of supporting evidence. The gruelling preparation process cost him approximately ₹12 lakh in out-of-pocket legal fees.

item.title: Todd Blanche refuses to pledge DOJ will always act independently of President Trump
item.description: Todd Blanche was asked whether he could guarantee the justice department's independence from the White House. “No, I’m not going to pledge that,” Blanche said. “And no attorney general ever should.”

item.title: Jharkhand job exam row: Students agree to fresh talks with govt on Aug 17, maintain demands
item.description: Students protesting alleged irregularities in Jharkhand recruitment exams have agreed to fresh talks with the state government on August 17, but said the meeting will be held in the presence of their legal adviser and they will not withdraw their demands.

item.title: NASA engineer by day, voiceover artist at night: How a ₹19,000 deficit led to a ₹30.5 lakh side hustle from closet
item.description: Eryn Andrews, who has a master's degree in space studies, used the online freelance marketplace Fiverr to find gigs.

item.title: Complaints filed against Sonia Gandhi in Delhi, Karnataka over 'Vande Mataram' row at Congress headquarters
item.description: Complaints have been filed against Sonia Gandhi in Delhi and Karnataka over an alleged disruption during Vande Mataram's rendition at Congress headquarters on Independence Day. The Congress denied any attempt to stop the National Song.

item.title: Former Iran president Khatami warns against prolonged war, urges diplomacy with US, Israel: ‘We cannot live with war’
item.description: Khatami said the Islamic Republic had survived foreign aggression and remained resilient, but argued that continued conflict would create serious challenges for the country and its people.

item.title: PSB Confluence to focus on youth, deposits as Modi sets global ambition for Indian banking
item.description: The department of financial services is hosting PSB Confluence 2026 on Monday and Tuesday in New Delhi, bringing together nearly 125 senior leaders from PSBs and public financial institutions.

item.title: Pope Leo renews call to end West Bank violence, urges international action on two-state solution
item.description: The West Bank has experienced a sharp increase in settler violence and tensions in recent years, alongside continued Israeli settlement expansion.

item.title: Belgium student unearths ₹99-crore gold stash during routine sewer work under former brewery. But he can't keep it
item.description: An 18-year-old student in Belgium reportedly unearthed a hidden stash of gold worth approximately ₹99 crore while working at a construction site. The treasure, consisting of coins and bullion, was discovered in a sealed section of a cellar wall at a former brewery.

item.title: Sania Mirza's quirky extra hour socialising ‘against will’ for son post goes viral; netizens cheer Motherhood Chronicle
item.description: Sania Mirza and Shoaib Malik welcomed their son, Izhaan Mirza Malik, in October 2018. The couple officially announced their separation in 2024. Izhaan currently lives with Sania in India.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war escalates: Ukraine launches 822 drones at Russia, NATO jet intercepts drone over Romania
item.description: At least six people were killed in Ukraine's attacks on Russia, while Russian strikes killed at least five people in Ukraine and wounded several others.

item.title: Trump shares throwback picture with Kim Jong Un, says they 'get along great despite unfriendly look'
item.description: US President Donald Trump shared a throwback photo with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, saying they get along great. The post comes amid renewed interest in US-North Korea diplomacy and tensions over US-South Korea military drills.

item.title: Varanasi airport firing: Injured screeners recall tense moments as passenger's pistol went off— ‘It was loaded. Then…'
item.description: A licensed firearm discharged accidentally at Varanasi airport during security checks, injuring two staff members. The passenger, who had declared the weapon, has been detained as authorities investigate the incident, which occurred around 9:30 am.

item.title: Mint Explainer | What India’s new foreign asset disclosure rules mean for taxpayers
item.description: New rules offer a ₹1 lakh route for some taxpayers, while those with undisclosed foreign assets or income could face a payment of 60% of the value

item.title: Has actor Antarra Banerjee been arrested? Kasauti Zindagi Kay actor's team issues clarification
item.description: Actor Antarra Banerjee’s team on Sunday denied her involvement in the alleged RPF personnel “attack” aboard the Aravali Express on August 12, saying the FIR names Thane-based model Antara Soham Banerjee, not the actor.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee mourns ex-TMC MLA Asish Banerjee, flags 'mental pressure' before death
item.description: In a post on X, Banerjee said Banerjee, a five-term MLA, former Deputy Speaker and Chairman, had spent much of his life teaching and serving people in Rampurhat and Birbhum.

item.title: Vimal Elaichi or surrogate pan masala ad? Why Tukaram Mundhe-led Maharashtra FDA flagged SRK, Ajay Devgn campaign
item.description: Maharashtra FDA has issued notices to Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff over a Vimal Elaichi ad, alleging it could indirectly promote prohibited pan masala. The actors have 15 days to respond.

item.title: Flipkart's Freedom Sale ad faces heat for being ‘self-serving, insensitive’; netizens react — ‘Very bad analogy, but...’
item.description: Social media users had a mixed response to Flipkart's ad — While everyone saw it as awkward or attention-seeking dark humour, some pointed out that it was not worthy of outrage, noting its creative play on the pressure to end sales.

item.title: Notice for Vimal Elaichi ad, Blinkit dark stores' licence suspension: Tukaram Mundhe’s FDA crackdown in Maharashtra
item.description: The Maharashtra FDA suspended 14 food business licenses linked to Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart for severe food safety violations after statewide inspections. It has served show-cause notices on actors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff over their endorsement of Vimal Elaichi.

item.title: Did PM Modi label Opposition as 'Dimagi Naxal' in his I-Day speech? Kiren Rijiju clarifies amid row
item.description: Kiren Rijiju said PM Modi's 'dimagi Naxal' remark was not aimed at Opposition leaders, but at those supporting Maoists, separatism and attempts to isolate the Northeast. Congress leader Jairam Ramesh criticised the term.

item.title: Who is Cami Clark? All about Jeffrey Epstein links to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s little-known wife
item.description: According to the WSJ, only a little information is available about Cami Clark online, alleging that there have been efforts to remove references to her from the internet.

item.title: Abhijeet Dipke reveals Swades' Shah Rukh Khan inspired him to return to India, serve his village: ‘Just like Mohan’
item.description: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) found Abhijeet Dipke recalled watching Swades multiple times and being inspired by Shah Rukh Khan's character Mohan in the film. Check what he said as he launched 'School Thik Karo' campaign.

item.title: 'Mileage depends on more than fuel': Govt allays E20 concerns; cites 'driving habits', 'AC usage' amid intense debate
item.description: The government has sought to allay concerns over E20 petrol and mileage, saying fuel economy depends on driving, traffic, maintenance, tyre pressure and AC use. It said E20 has undergone extensive testing and validation.

item.title: ₹2.5 lakh to move into a 3BHK? Bengaluru couple details breakdown in viral video
item.description: A Bengaluru couple has shared a detailed breakdown of what it cost them to move into a three-bedroom apartment in South Bengaluru — from a hefty security deposit to broker fees and shipping furniture from Kolkata — with the total crossing ₹2.5 lakh.&nbsp;

item.title: PM Modi reveals ‘special’ morning routine, feeds peacocks, cows before setting off for the day | Watch
item.description: PM Modi recalled pet's reaction on Independence Day as he shared heartfelt moment spent feeding peacocks and cows. Sharing a glimpse of morning hours before 15 August speech, the prime minister revealed his morning routine.

item.title: Indian Navy sailor, wife, two children found dead in Mumbai's Navy Nagar residence on Independence Day
item.description: In a tragic incident on Independence Day, an Indian Navy sailor, along with his wife and their two young children, was found dead inside their residential quarters at Navy Nagar in Colaba, Mumbai, on Saturday.

item.title: Watch: After 33 years at XLRI, professor gets emotional guard-of-honour farewell from students, staff
item.description: A professor at XLRI Jamshedpur received an emotional farewell from students and faculty after completing 33 years at the institute, with a video of the moment — shared on LinkedIn by colleague — showing Professor Venugopal Pingali walking through a corridor lined with applauding students and staff.

item.title: Quote of the day by Elbert Hubbard on persistence: ‘Self-discipline is the ability to make yourself do what you….’
item.description: Elbert Hubbard' quote promotes persistence amid distractions. highlights the value of small consistent efforts and underscores that success is achieved through patience and discipline rather than mere motivation.
